# Roshni Subudhi

> Senior Product Manager in Bengaluru, India, with 10+ years across payments, loyalty, travel, fintech and e-commerce. Founding PM of JioOnePay at Jio Platforms (₹5,000 Cr / ₹50B monthly payment volume, 30+ merchants) and led Expedia Group's unified global loyalty platform for 50M+ customers. Builds with AI: agentic workflows, LLMs, RAG and MCP. Open to Senior PM roles in payments, platforms and AI, in Bengaluru or remote. Most recent role: Expedia Group (Aug 2024 – Feb 2026).

Contact: roshnisubudhi23@gmail.com · LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/roshnisubudhi/ · GitHub: https://github.com/roshnisubudhi6
